title: Add security hardening flags to Makefile
description:
The Makefile is missing standard security hardening flags that every crypto library should carry:

Missing from CFLAGS:
- -fstack-protector-strong (stack canaries)
- -D_FORTIFY_SOURCE=2 (fortified libc calls)
- -O2 (required for _FORTIFY_SOURCE to work)
- -Wformat=2 -Wformat-security (format string bugs)

Missing from LDFLAGS:
- -Wl,-z,relro (read-only relocations)
- -Wl,-z,now (eager binding / full RELRO)
- -Wl,-z,noexecstack (NX stack)

For the CLI binary specifically: -fPIE / -pie (position-independent executable).

Add each flag with an inline comment explaining what it does and why it matters for a crypto library. Check for GCC/clang compatibility (some flags differ).
